LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Lanius.label: Lanius
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Lanius.description:
A large drone platform able to carry infantry-caliber firearms, built to give fire cover to ultraheavy mother-drones in ground battles where air superiority is already held. Its lift structure is fragile, so it carries two smoke-grenade launchers to screen itself from incoming fire.
It flies over terrain no ground unit can cross and can mount a wider range of weapons than the Falcon, but its armament is limited to weapons an infantryman could carry. The launchers hold four smoke charges in total.
